R-Music adaptations (2026-10-31): React/WebView implementation of floating navigation, rounded mini/full player, colour palettes and motion timings, using the existing R-Music Core and native audio engine. No Liser branding, illustration or audio engine is included. R-Music source is distributed under AGPL-3.0.
